pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card are asked for at check-in, and the resort wants your arrival time in advance.

pills.label: 54 m² Bliss room
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: The Bliss room (581 ft², king bed) has a balcony, a bath and a separate shower, with a yukata and fruit laid out for guests. Breakfast is included at the €570 rate.

pills.label: Kids 7+ pay adult
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children of any age are welcome, but from 7 years they are charged as adults; extra beds for 7+ are free. No kids' club is listed. Wheelchair accessible, with an emergency cord in the bathroom.

pills.label: 500 m private beach
pills.pop_html: Beach: 500 metres of private beachfront on Bluewaters Island, facing the Gulf with Ain Dubai behind. JBR and Dubai Marina are across the bridge, Marina Beach is 1.4 km away.

pills.label: Demon Duck + 2 more
pills.pop_html: Dining: Demon Duck by Alvin Leung (Chinese), Alizée (French) and Tocha (international, also high tea). A breakfast-and-dinner rate for the Bliss room is €657.

pills.label: Banyan Tree Spa
pills.pop_html: Spa and pool: The signature Banyan Tree Spa with sauna and steam room, plus a heated outdoor pool with a shallow end set in gardens.

pills.label: Island resort
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Asian-styled rooms in natural materials, lush gardens and an island position across the bridge from JBR. Guests score comfort 9.7 and location 9.6, among the top marks here.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the joint best-reviewed beach resort on this list (9.5), a 500 m private beach and breakfast included at €570 a night.
best_for.skip_html: if you travel with children over 6: they pay adult rates and no kids' club is listed, so Le Meridien (#4) or Four Seasons (#3) suit families better.

pills.label: Breakfast included

pills.label: 5 restaurants

pills.label: Beach resort at JBR
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A full-service beach resort with a large pool and sun terrace, squash courts and a spa with sauna and steam room. Location scores 9.3.

best_for.pick_html: for couples and friends who want a real private beach at JBR with breakfast included for €231, the lowest breakfast-included price on this list.
best_for.skip_html: if room size matters: the 36 m² Deluxe is one of the smallest rooms here; Habtoor Grand (#8) gives 40 m² for less, without breakfast in the rate.

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Unlike most resorts here there is no minimum check-in age.

pills.label: 70 m² Deluxe
pills.pop_html: Cheapest room: Deluxe City View Room (753 ft², king bed) with balcony, the biggest entry room on this list. Bathrooms have a deep soaking tub, rain shower and a mirror with built-in TV.

pills.label: Free beds to 17
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Special programmes for younger guests; free cots for 0–2 and free extra beds for 3–17. PlayStation or Xbox on request. Wheelchair accessible, with lower sink and raised toilet.

pills.label: Private beach
pills.pop_html: Beach: A private beach on Jumeirah Beach with cabanas and day villas for in-house guests, plus a jogging track close to the sand.

pills.label: 3 pools
pills.pop_html: Pools: Two outdoor pools and an indoor pool, a hot tub and a lavish spa, plus tennis and padel courts.

pills.label: Mercury Rooftop
pills.pop_html: Dining: Sea Fu (seafood), Jou Jou Brasserie, Shai Salon and Mercury Rooftop on the sixth floor, facing Burj Khalifa. Hendricks bar overlooks the sea.

pills.label: Beach near Downtown
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Modern rooms with Arabic touches on a beach 15 minutes' drive from Burj Khalifa. Guests score cleanliness, comfort and staff 9.7, among the highest on the page.

pills.label: Unlimited Wild Wadi

pills.label: World's highest pool
pills.pop_html: Pools: 4 open-air pools, including the record-holding outdoor infinity pool about 294 m up, with views of Bluewaters, Ain Dubai, the Palm and the Marina.

pills.label: Beachfront at JBR
pills.pop_html: Beach: Beachfront at the JBR end, with direct access to The Walk; The Beach Grill restaurant sits by the sand.

pills.pop_html: The vibe: Two 77-storey towers joined by a sky bridge, with The Walk at JBR at the door and a spa on the 75th floor. Comfort 9.7.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the world's highest infinity pool, nine restaurants and The Walk at JBR outside, with breakfast and 2PM check-out for €474.
best_for.skip_html: if you travel with young children who want the sky pool after 11:30 (16+ only), or want the beach without a city tower: Banyan Tree (#1) is on an island.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want the Nikki Beach Club on the doorstep, a 55 m² room and breakfast for €434, 15 minutes from Dubai International.
